failure_contract.before_effect: All original byte, inode, owner, group, mode, size and mtime pins checked before attempt directory; renewed exact body/fingerprint CAS after durable intent.
failure_contract.partial_effect: No automatic rollback/retry. source_file_installed is null when a replacement was attempted or a prior attempt is detected, until accepted. Read-only reconciliation reports current preimage/owned postimage/unknown.
failure_contract.retry_fence: Fixed private attempt directory remains after a partial attempt; a different request is blocked before replacement. Existing lease is the only lock.
failure_contract.rollback: Executable explicit same-retained-transaction rollback is only available for unaccepted replacement and exact owned staged inode/body; verified0600 original backup is required. Foreign identical bytes with different inode block rollback. Entry never calls rollback automatically.
failure_contract.process_loss: After process loss, retained backup/phase records are evidence for a separately reviewed reconciliation; no command claims replay authority.
failure_contract.successful_install: Durable backup, postimage source, directory fsync, phase receipt and final readback; active preexisting bash generation remains unverified.

cases: real file install with mode/uid/gid preserved and private0600 backup

focused_tests.isolation: Only TemporaryDirectory files and an existing fixture flock are touched. Production source hashes remain pinned; only ROOT/native metadata/UID are substituted for local fixtures. No source application is executed.
focused_tests.corrected_during_local_test: Initial fixture run revealed Python default uid=OWNER_UID captured production0 before fixture injection. Defaults now resolve to immutable production OWNER_UID/BEFORE gid at call time; native constants remain0 and no native permission requirement changed.

Cache actual installed_identity from the existing final owned_postimage readback; zero extra reads

route.owner_authorization: Retained existing operator exact-owner issue-comment/source-commit checks; installer does not create a new bridge or credential path.
route.remote_blob_discrepancy_resolved: Removed one local extra terminal newline; root uses unchanged remote operator/tree.
route.payload_wrapper: The installer file itself is the complete stdlib-only payload; copy its exact bytes to the already verified mutating repair entrypoint. Do not wrap it in a second lease or run the read-only diagnostic entrypoint.

next: Root alone publishes exact reviewed payload, performs fresh claimed single-file repair, and reconciles the lossless native receipt before any retry. No additional source or server audit is required by this installer.
successful_readback: Bounded actual installed_identity (dev,ino,uid,gid,mode,bytes,mtime_ns) is returned only on accepted installation, from the already executed final source readback. Preserve lossless JSON integers.
